artifact.name: WAKKA Android Build Capsule Public Core
artifact.description: Shareable Android build orchestration with a separately generated private SDK runtime and an original plain-Java demo.

intent.purpose: Preserve conversational Android iteration while distributing only the owned core and obtaining SDK tools separately.
audiences: People using a chat with code execution
success_criteria: Public ZIP contains only allowlisted owned code/docs/example and no SDK binary or private key.
Fresh private runtime builds the example from Java source to a signed APK with verified v1/v2/v3 signatures.
An existing owner Capsule remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
out_of_scope: Accepting third-party licenses for a user
Claiming a device test from an APK build

entry_points.role: Create a private Linux SDK runtime on Windows

environment: Windows 10/11 target for runtime maker; owner Windows setup confirmed, exact version not recorded
Linux x86_64 + Python 3.10+ + JDK 17+ for compilation
operation.network_notes: Runtime acquisition uses official Google downloads after personal license acceptance. Completed compilation is offline. This metadata grants no additional network or signing authority.

ignore: Any project keystores or personal media

allowed_actions: Verify the public core and SDK inventory
must: Use current user authority for edits and signing
Keep owner runtime bundles and signing keys separate from public releases
Retain third-party notices in private runtimes
must_not: Copy the original private Capsule into a public release
Publish a generated private SDK bundle as this public core
Replace an existing app signing identity without the owner choosing that change

approved_contexts: Public core may be shared under MIT
data_handling.notes: This classification applies to public core files only. Generated SDK runtimes and signing keys have separate handling.

setup: Create or import an owner-authorized private runtime
edit: Update public checksums after material changes
build: Use build for plain Java or run-project for an inspected existing Bash builder
verify: Build from a fresh runtime extraction
Check public allowlist for excluded files
release: Complete the Windows maker UI/device tests before claiming them
recovery: Keep the original private Capsule as the known-good separate baseline

checks.description: Public payload excludes SDKs and keys
checks.expected: Only owned core, documentation and demo
APK, evidence, v1/v2/v3 true and alignment pass

approvers: Current owner of the target project
authority.change_policy: Follow the current user instruction. Public code may be forked under MIT; target signing authority is separate.

safe_first_actions: Inspect the current project build requirements

review.notes: Owner confirms public setup success. The generated runtime was freshly extracted and built CapsuleDemo from source; Android device behavior remains untested.
